notes: The italic *I will not go up* answers to no source token; its words stand together and do one office, so they are one added unit headed on *go* (rules 2, 7).

*and then* is read as one rendering of the single waw at the clause's left edge, on rule 55's pair reasoning rather than leaving *then* added under rule 51's count; the reading is named in the unit note.
אֶת־פְּנֵי is the preposition H854 with its construct noun, fused into the single *before* and headed on the construct (rules 23, 30).
